blank_space.notes: No hole over 1.5 sq in on either page. The largest measured gaps are 1.0 sq in on page 1 (beside the lead headline, which is normal ragged type) and 0.94 sq in on page 2. Footer gaps are 0.07–0.15in, tighter than the approved reference.

even_gaps.notes: Measured inter-block gaps are 6.2–8.3pt on both pages. Nothing touches and no gap looks bigger than the others.

no_widows.notes: No stranded word at the top of a column or box. Table cells wrap to at most 2–3 lines. The 'Cadet Challenger' and 'Y12 Women' wraps in Club Results also appear in the approved reference, and the 3-line Fairfax deadline cell is not a sliver.

photo_sizing.notes: Both page-1 photos are full column width and read as strong art, like the approved layout. The podium photo is about 3.5in tall and the coaching photo about 6in. Page 2 has no art, and no rubric item requires any.

focal_point.notes: The page-1 lead headline and its long story dominate the left, with the large photos on the right. Like the reference, the lead is text-led, and no other block competes with it.

alignment.notes: Column bottoms are close on both pages: the page-1 left column ends at about 2080px, the center column at about 2000px, and the right column at about 2035px. The page-2 columns end at about 2035px and 2045px. Rules, boxes and the vertical column rules are consistent.

issues.problem: This column ends about 0.1in higher than the left column and the right photo credit, so the bottoms are not perfectly flush.
issues.fix: Add about 8–10 words to the Holiday Party item, or trim the left column's Club Closed story by about one line.

issues.where: Cobra story, last lines of paragraphs ('to 15.', 'regional results.')
issues.problem: Short last lines at paragraph ends make the text a little ragged.
issues.fix: Trim about 3 words from the SYC format paragraph so 'to 15.' pulls back up.

issues.where: 'On the Road — December SJCC' box header
issues.problem: The title wraps onto two lines, orphaning 'SJCC'.
issues.fix: Shorten the title to 'On the Road — SJCC'.

issues.problem: The date column is right-aligned with a wide left indent, and the What's Due cells wrap to 2–3 lines.
issues.fix: Tighten the wording of the Fairfax row, for example 'Fairfax Challenge: last regular-fee day'.

issues.problem: Page 2 has no picture or art, unlike the approved reference, which had a cartoon. The page reads as dense gray text.
issues.fix: If art is available, add a small cartoon or photo to the right column, or leave as is.

critique.summary: Both pages are tightly filled with even gaps, no holes, no stranded widows and no table slivers, and the page-1 lead and photos work as a focal point. Only minor polish items remain, so the proof passes.
